prompt: The heights of adult men in a city are approximately normal with mean $70$ inches and standard deviation $3$ inches. About what percent of these men are between $67$ and $73$ inches tall?
hint: Check how far $67$ and $73$ are from the mean, in standard deviations.

hints.text: Check how far $67$ and $73$ are from the mean, in standard deviations.
$67 = 70 - 3$ and $73 = 70 + 3$: one SD on each side. The empirical rule (68-95-99.7) says how much lives within one SD.
About $68$ percent of the men are between $67$ and $73$ inches.

explanation: $67$ is one SD below the mean and $73$ is one SD above it.
For a normal distribution, about $68$ percent of values fall within one SD of the mean.
So about $68$ percent of the men are $67$ to $73$ inches tall.

alternativeExplanations.title: Symmetry check
steps: Half of the 68 percent, or 34 percent, sits between 70 and 73.
The other 34 percent sits between 67 and 70.
